points: \item Architected and deployed enterprise-scale RAG systems using LangChain and Mistral 7B on Azure OpenAI, improving document intelligence accuracy by ~20% and enabling multi-agent orchestration with vector search pipelines (FAISS, Pinecone, Azure Cognitive Search).

\item Engineered hybrid retrieval architecture combining dense embeddings with metadata-based retrieval and re-ranking strategies, achieving 35% improvement in document chunking, context window optimization, and semantic search relevance for enterprise clients.

\item Developed LLM-as-Judge evaluation framework with prompt engineering optimization to assess RAG pipeline faithfulness, latency, and accuracy across hundreds of enterprise search scenarios, ensuring production-ready reliability and scalability.

\item Optimized multi-agent inference workflows through batched query processing and agent orchestration, reducing API calls by ~80% and cutting Azure ML costs by 60% while maintaining sub-second latency for performant AI solutions.

\item Designed ML-based anomaly detection system for agent validation and monitoring with embedding model optimization, reducing false positives by 25% while maintaining secure deployment and improving operational efficiency.

\item Fine-tuned Llama-3.1-8B using QLoRA on enterprise domain data with 4-bit quantization, gaining hands-on experience in parameter-efficient LLM training and deploying AI agents in Agile sprints with DevSecOps collaboration.
